definitions.gloss: samurai family, warrior household, warrior class
definitions.explanation: A family belonging to the warrior class in feudal Japan, or the warrior class as a whole. Used in historical contexts to distinguish the military aristocracy from the court nobility (公家).

examples.japanese: {武家|ぶけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A samurai family's residence has been preserved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鎌倉|かまくら}→鎌倉：30711_kamakura⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{武家|ぶけ}⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}した→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧。
examples.english: A warrior government was established in the Kamakura period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{武家|ぶけ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{公家|くげ}→公家：12664_kuge⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{社会的|しゃかいてき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}め→占める：11799_shimeru⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦させた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the Edo period, the warrior class and the court nobility held different social positions and each developed their own distinct culture.

notes:
USAGE:
A historical term referring to the samurai class or individual samurai families. Contrasts with ⟦{公家|くげ}→公家：12664_kuge⟧ (court nobility). The {武家|ぶけ} class dominated Japanese politics from the Kamakura period (1185) until the Meiji Restoration (1868).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {武家|ぶけ}⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧: warrior government
- {武家|ぶけ}⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧: samurai residence
- {武家|ぶけ}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: warrior society
- {武家|ぶけ}{諸法度|しょはっと}: Laws for the Military Houses
